subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Counts legs of plasticine animals; older and younger

show.line: Let's make clay animals! A chicken has two legs. A cow has four legs. Count with me!

rounds.prompt: A beetle has lots of legs. Count them.
Count the spider's legs. Go slowly!
The hen and her chick. Which one is younger?
rounds.praise: Yes! The baby chick is younger.

rounds.prompt: The cow and her calf. Who is older, the cow or the calf? Say it.

hints: Touch each leg as you count. One, two, three.
A baby is younger. A mother is older.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the cow's legs.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One, two. A cow has two legs!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I forgot the back legs. A cow has four legs.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. One, two, three, four. Four legs!

parent_line: Can count animal legs to 8 and say who is older or younger.
